## Standard

<a id="Mermaid"></a>

### Mermaid

`Mermaid` · `src/mermaid.ts:11`

The syntax of the diagrams that Trame's documents contain: flowcharts and Gantt charts. The marks that several constructs share are here.

Source: Mermaid 11: flowcharts and Gantt charts · `https://mermaid.js.org/intro/syntax-reference.html`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `indent` | `"  "` | Shifts a statement inside its block: Mermaid ignores it, it helps reading |
| `space` | `" "` | Separates a keyword from what it introduces |
| `quote` | `"` | Surrounds a label |
| `language` | `mermaid` | The name of the language, in the info string of a code block that carries a diagram (GitHub, GitLab) |

- Maintained by: trame
- Defines: [Class definition](#ClassDefinition), [Flowchart](#Flowchart), [Gantt chart](#Gantt), [Name in a Gantt chart](#GanttName), [Section](#GanttSection), [Task](#GanttTask), [Label](#MermaidLabel), [Link](#MermaidLink), [Node](#MermaidNode), [Milestone](#Milestone), [Node style](#NodeStyle), [Style properties](#StyleProperties), [Subgraph](#Subgraph)
